fields.title: Handmade Palm Basket
fields.description: Eco-friendly basket made from Egyptian palm leaves. Perfect for home storage or as a decorative piece. Crafted by local artisans with durable weaving.

fields.title: Nile Cotton Bedsheet Set
fields.description: Luxurious Egyptian cotton bedsheet set offering comfort and breathability. Designed for durability and a silky soft feel for restful sleep.

fields.title: Alabaster Candle Holder
fields.description: Elegant alabaster candle holder that adds a warm ambiance to any home. Each piece is uniquely hand-carved by skilled Egyptian artisans.

fields.title: Fayoum Pottery Vase
fields.description: Traditional hand-painted vase from Fayoum pottery. Adds authentic Egyptian artistry to home décor with vibrant, long-lasting designs.

fields.title: Luxor Cotton Towels
fields.description: Set of 3 ultra-soft towels made from premium Egyptian cotton. Highly absorbent and gentle on the skin, ideal for everyday use.

fields.title: Handwoven Kilim Rug
fields.description: Authentic handwoven kilim rug from Upper Egypt. Adds warmth and tradition to living spaces with intricate patterns and colors.

fields.title: Papyrus Wall Art
fields.description: Hand-painted papyrus artwork depicting traditional Egyptian motifs. A cultural and decorative piece suitable for framing.

fields.title: Brass Lantern
fields.description: Traditional Egyptian brass lantern, perfect for Ramadan or evening gatherings. Creates a cozy atmosphere with intricate light patterns.

fields.title: Siwa Salt Lamp
fields.description: Natural salt lamp from Siwa oasis, known for its calming glow. Believed to improve air quality and enhance relaxation at home.

fields.title: Handmade Clay Teapot
fields.description: Rustic clay teapot handmade by Egyptian potters. Perfect for traditional tea serving and adds an authentic touch to the kitchen.
